ProjectName: AcmeCoffeeOnline - UAT DSL watermark integration smoke

Review.ItemLabel: SMOKE-1: Toggle Available on a product row; verify quiet
Review.Feedback: CATALOG GAP: /login and /dev/email-inbox are not in the crawled catalog by design (the crawler authenticates first). The pre-auth steps below use the standard sign-in flow. Additionally, no catalog row for /admin/products carries elementRole=grid with a userVisibleLabel naming the product table; the CLICK SWITCH step therefore omits the grid scope qualifier and identifies the target column solely by its header "Available", which IS present in the catalog as elementRole=Column on /admin/products x SystemAdmin.

Steps.Action: CLICK INPUT with label "Email address" and enter "admin@acmecoffee.com"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "Send sign-in link"
WAIT FOR "the page displays the text 'We sent a sign-in code to'"
WAIT FOR "an email row appears for admin@acmecoffee.com"
WAIT FOR "the page displays the text 'Product Administration'"
CLICK SWITCH in column with header "Available"
VERIFY ELEMENT with label "Available" is visible
